explanation: Worker to the implement of the trade: a mason spreads mortar with a trowel as a weaver makes cloth on a loom. Only this pair runs worker to tool in that order.

distractor_rationales.brick is to wall: topical associate, wrong internal relation — masonry field, but part to whole
distractor_rationales.lathe is to machinist: the correct relation REVERSED — tool to worker
distractor_rationales.quarry is to stone: related but different relation — source/location to material
distractor_rationales.kiln is to pottery: related but different relation — tool to the product it yields, not worker to tool

explanation: An angler works with a rod as a surgeon works with a scalpel — worker to the characteristic tool.

distractor_rationales.net is to fisherman: the correct relation REVERSED, and in the stem's own field
distractor_rationales.bait is to hook: topical associate, wrong relation — two things used together, neither a worker
distractor_rationales.oar is to rowing: related but different relation — tool to the activity it performs

explanation: The welder's working implement is the torch; the farmer's is the plow.

distractor_rationales.flame is to heat: related but different relation — cause to effect, in the stem's field
distractor_rationales.visor is to welder: the correct relation REVERSED — equipment to worker
distractor_rationales.steel is to girder: related but different relation — raw material to finished form
distractor_rationales.solder is to joint: topical associate — material to the result it creates

explanation: Worker to the tool that shapes the work: a tailor sews with a needle, a potter throws on a wheel.

distractor_rationales.thread is to seam: topical associate, wrong relation — material to result
distractor_rationales.easel is to painter: the correct relation REVERSED — tool to worker
distractor_rationales.suit is to lapel: related but different relation — whole to part, in the stem's field
distractor_rationales.shears is to cut: related but different relation — tool to function

explanation: The relation is worker to the implement he directs his charges with. Four choices stay inside the stem's musical field; only the shepherd and his crook leaves the field while keeping the relation exactly.

distractor_rationales.violinist is to sonata: topical associate, wrong relation — worker to product, not worker to tool
distractor_rationales.metronome is to tempo: related but different relation — instrument to the quantity it marks
distractor_rationales.podium is to conductor: the correct relation REVERSED, and an object of position rather than a tool

explanation: Degree, running from the slight condition to the extreme one: damp to saturated, cracked to shattered.

distractor_rationales.frozen is to chilly: right relation, wrong DIRECTION — extreme to slight
distractor_rationales.sponge is to water: topical associate, wrong relation — object to what it absorbs
distractor_rationales.drenched is to moist: right relation, wrong direction, and in the stem's own field
distractor_rationales.leak is to puddle: related but different relation — cause to effect

explanation: Mild feeling to intense feeling in the same direction: fond to devoted, hungry to ravenous.

distractor_rationales.furious is to irritated: right relation, wrong DIRECTION — intense to mild
distractor_rationales.affection is to loyalty: topical associate, wrong relation — two related qualities, not degrees of one
distractor_rationales.friend is to companion: related but different relation — near-synonyms of equal strength, no change of degree

explanation: A faint instance to an overwhelming instance of the same thing. Two other pairs change intensity but run the wrong way.

distractor_rationales.lantern is to light: topical associate, wrong relation — device to what it produces
distractor_rationales.downpour is to drizzle: right relation, wrong DIRECTION, and in the key's field to prevent field-matching

explanation: Moderate action to the same action performed intensely: jog to sprint, sip to guzzle.

distractor_rationales.devour is to nibble: right relation, wrong direction, in the key's field so topic cannot decide it
distractor_rationales.sprinter is to stopwatch: related but different relation — worker to tool, topically tied to the stem

explanation: Slight state to extreme state: uneasy to terrified, tired to exhausted.

distractor_rationales.fear is to flight: topical associate, wrong relation — cause to effect
distractor_rationales.nervous is to calm: related but different relation — antonyms, and topically tied to the stem

explanation: Maker to the thing made: a baker turns out a loaf as a blacksmith turns out a horseshoe.

distractor_rationales.oven is to baker: related but different relation REVERSED — tool to worker
distractor_rationales.portrait is to painter: the correct relation REVERSED — product to maker
distractor_rationales.crumb is to bread: topical associate, wrong relation — part to whole
distractor_rationales.hive is to honey: related but different relation — source to product, with no worker

explanation: Creator to the work created: composer and symphony, playwright and drama.

distractor_rationales.score is to composer: the correct relation REVERSED — work to creator
distractor_rationales.chorus is to singers: related but different relation — group to member
distractor_rationales.stage is to actor: topical associate, wrong relation — location to person

explanation: A vintner produces wine from grapes as a miller produces flour from grain — worker to product.

distractor_rationales.press is to vintner: related but different relation REVERSED — tool to worker
distractor_rationales.cask is to cellar: topical associate, wrong relation — object to location
distractor_rationales.vinegar is to sour: related but different relation — thing to characteristic

explanation: Craftsman to the object he fashions: glassblower and vase, jeweler and brooch.

distractor_rationales.furnace is to glassblower: the correct relation REVERSED, with a tool in place of a product
distractor_rationales.vase is to porcelain: topical associate, wrong relation — object to material
distractor_rationales.gem is to mine: related but different relation — material to its source

explanation: The relation is the writer to what his labor produces. Four choices sit inside the poetry field and none of them is a maker-to-work pair; the lexicographer leaves the field but reproduces the relation.

distractor_rationales.stanza is to refrain: topical associate, wrong relation — two parts of a poem
distractor_rationales.meter is to rhythm: topical associate — near-synonyms of a technical quality
distractor_rationales.essay is to essayist: the correct relation REVERSED — work to writer
distractor_rationales.anthology is to poems: related but different relation — collection to members

explanation: The tradesman and the goods that come out of his shop: a printer turns out pamphlets, a tanner turns out leather.

distractor_rationales.ink is to press: topical associate, wrong relation — material used with a machine
distractor_rationales.typeface is to font: related but different relation — near-synonyms, no making involved
distractor_rationales.manuscript is to editor: the correct relation REVERSED — object worked on to the worker

explanation: The person who composes the work to the work itself: choreographer and ballet, cartoonist and comic strip.

distractor_rationales.dancer is to leap: topical associate, wrong relation — performer to a single action, not a composed work
distractor_rationales.troupe is to dancer: related but different relation — group to member

explanation: Builder to the structure he builds: a bricklayer raises a wall, a shipwright builds a hull.

distractor_rationales.level is to bricklayer: the correct relation REVERSED, with a tool in place of a product
distractor_rationales.keel is to ship: topical associate in the key's field, wrong relation — part to whole
distractor_rationales.mast is to sail: related but different relation — two parts that work together

explanation: A process and what it produces over time: friction produces heat, erosion produces a canyon. The trap is that three choices sit in the mechanical field and one simply mirrors the stem.

distractor_rationales.axle is to wheel: topical associate, wrong relation — two parts fitted together
distractor_rationales.lubricant is to friction: related but different relation — the agent that PREVENTS the condition
distractor_rationales.heat is to friction: the correct relation REVERSED — effect to cause
distractor_rationales.gravel is to road: related but different relation — material to finished thing

explanation: Something said to the feeling it creates in the hearer: an insult breeds resentment, praise breeds confidence.

distractor_rationales.resentment is to grudge: related but different relation — degree, and it reuses the stem's own second word as a decoy
distractor_rationales.apology is to quarrel: related but different relation — the remedy for a condition rather than its cause
distractor_rationales.compliment is to flattery: topical associate, wrong relation — degree of intensity

explanation: Something applied and the beneficial result it brings about: a vaccine confers immunity, fertilizer produces growth.

distractor_rationales.immunity is to vaccine: the correct relation REVERSED — effect to cause
distractor_rationales.syringe is to nurse: topical associate, wrong relation — tool to worker
distractor_rationales.vitamin is to nutrient: related but different relation — member to category

explanation: Excess of a normally good thing to the damage that excess causes: overwork causes burnout, overwatering causes rot. The doing-too-much is load-bearing, which is why 'rest is to fatigue' fails.

distractor_rationales.rest is to fatigue: related but different relation — the cure for a condition, not its cause
distractor_rationales.burnout is to overwork: the correct relation REVERSED — effect to cause
distractor_rationales.watering can is to gardener: topical associate of the KEY, wrong relation — tool to worker

explanation: Prolonged exposure to a condition and the harm it produces: humidity brings mildew, sunlight brings sunburn.

distractor_rationales.mildew is to fungus: topical associate, wrong relation — member to category
distractor_rationales.dehumidifier is to humidity: related but different relation — the device that REMOVES the condition
distractor_rationales.attic is to dust: topical associate — location to what collects there
distractor_rationales.rust is to moisture: the correct relation REVERSED — damage to the condition that caused it

explanation: An event and the public feeling it sets off: a rumor sets off panic, a delay sets off frustration.

distractor_rationales.applause is to performance: the correct relation REVERSED — response to the thing that prompted it
distractor_rationales.crowd is to spectator: related but different relation — group to member
distractor_rationales.hearsay is to evidence: topical associate, wrong relation — contrast rather than cause

explanation: A sustained deprivation and the condition it produces: going without sleep produces irritability, going without nourishment produces weakness.

distractor_rationales.remedy is to ailment: related but different relation — cure to condition, the reverse of cause
distractor_rationales.insomnia is to sleeplessness: topical associate — near-synonyms drawn from the stem's own field
distractor_rationales.pillow is to sleeper: topical associate, wrong relation — object to user
distractor_rationales.fatigue is to drowsiness: topical associate, wrong relation — two symptoms of equal standing, neither causing the other

explanation: Accumulated matter and the visible formation it produces: pollution accumulates into smog, sediment accumulates into a delta.

distractor_rationales.smog is to city: topical associate, wrong relation — thing to location
distractor_rationales.filter is to pollution: related but different relation — the device that REMOVES the thing
distractor_rationales.smoke is to factory: the correct relation REVERSED — product to its source
distractor_rationales.river is to bank: topical associate of the key, wrong relation — whole to part

explanation: A destructive event and the residue it leaves: an earthquake leaves rubble, a wildfire leaves ash.

distractor_rationales.tremor is to earthquake: related but different relation — degree of intensity, in the stem's field
distractor_rationales.rubble is to debris: topical associate — near-synonyms, reusing the stem's second word
distractor_rationales.fault is to crust: topical associate, wrong relation — part to whole
distractor_rationales.extinguisher is to fire: related but different relation — the agent that STOPS the event, and topically tied to the key

explanation: Opposed physical properties: what is brittle snaps rather than bends, what is pliant bends; what is opaque blocks light, what is transparent passes it.

distractor_rationales.glass is to brittle: topical associate, wrong relation — object to characteristic
distractor_rationales.clay is to pottery: related but different relation — material to product
distractor_rationales.flexible is to supple: related but different relation — synonyms rather than opposites, and a trap for students who match on 'bendable'
distractor_rationales.sturdy is to unbreakable: related but different relation — degree of intensity, not opposition

explanation: Too little of something to far too much of it — opposites at the extremes of one scale. Silence is the absence of sound; a din is an overwhelming excess of it.

distractor_rationales.glut is to surplus: topical associate, wrong relation — near-synonyms, and it recycles the stem's second word
distractor_rationales.famine is to hunger: related but different relation — cause to effect, in the stem's economic field
distractor_rationales.echo is to cavern: related but different relation — phenomenon to location, topically tied to the key

explanation: Opposed ways of behaving: reckless against cautious, clumsy against graceful.

distractor_rationales.cautious is to careful: related but different relation — synonyms, using a word lifted straight from the stem
distractor_rationales.reckless is to accident: topical associate, wrong relation — cause to effect
distractor_rationales.acrobat is to balance: related but different relation — person to a quality he possesses
distractor_rationales.helmet is to cyclist: topical associate, wrong relation — equipment to user

explanation: Full of life against empty of it: fertile land teems, barren land does not; a crowded place is thick with people, a deserted one has none.

distractor_rationales.barren is to desert: topical associate, wrong relation — characteristic to the place that has it, recycling the stem's second word
distractor_rationales.seed is to sprout: related but different relation — cause to effect
distractor_rationales.fertile is to fruitful: related but different relation — synonyms, using the stem's own first word

explanation: The opposition is between the unpaid or unofficial version and the real, sanctioned one. Counterfeit stands opposed to genuine in exactly that way. The item is hard because three choices share surface vocabulary with the stem and one shares the key's field.

distractor_rationales.professional is to expert: topical associate, wrong relation — near-synonyms, using the stem's own second word
distractor_rationales.hobby is to amateur: topical associate — pursuit to the person who takes it up
distractor_rationales.forger is to banknote: topical associate of the KEY, wrong relation — worker to product
distractor_rationales.novel is to fiction: related but different relation — member to category

explanation: Directly opposed actions: to expand is to grow outward and to contract is to draw inward; to attract is to draw toward and to repel is to drive away.

distractor_rationales.magnet is to iron: topical associate of the KEY, wrong relation — object to what it acts on
distractor_rationales.balloon is to inflate: related but different relation — object to the action performed on it
distractor_rationales.expand is to enlarge: related but different relation — synonyms, using the stem's own first word
distractor_rationales.heat is to expansion: topical associate, wrong relation — cause to effect

explanation: To deplete is to draw a supply down and to replenish is to build it back; to tarnish is to let a surface dull and to polish is to bring it back. Each pair is a spoiling action against its undoing.

distractor_rationales.silver is to tarnish: topical associate of the KEY, wrong relation — material to what happens to it
distractor_rationales.replenish is to restock: related but different relation — synonyms, using the stem's own second word
distractor_rationales.reservoir is to water: topical associate, wrong relation — container to contents
distractor_rationales.depletion is to shortage: topical associate, wrong relation — cause to effect, built from the stem's first word
